help.accuracy: 100 % minus the average deviation of the forecast from the real price. Compare it with the naive guess — that shows the real value.
help.baseline: How often the AI was more accurate than simply assuming the price stays the same.
help.confidence: How sure the AI model says it is (0–100 %). It's the model's own estimate — the accuracy history shows how reliable it really is.
help.direction: Share of forecasts that correctly predicted whether the price would rise or fall. 50 % is a coin flip.
help.fearGreed: Market mood from 0 (extreme fear) to 100 (extreme greed), source alternative.me. Updated once a day.
help.macd: Shows trend momentum: when the MACD line crosses above the signal line, momentum is turning up; below it, turning down.
help.risk: How volatile and uncertain the AI considers the move (Low / Medium / High).
help.rsi: Relative Strength Index (0–100). Above 70 = possibly overbought, below 30 = possibly oversold.
help.sectors: How your portfolio is split across crypto sectors (DeFi, L1/L2, AI, memes…). Heavy concentration in one sector means higher risk.
help.sma: Simple moving average — smooths out short-term noise so the trend is easier to see.
help.whales: Large on-chain transfers (over $1M; DOGE over $0.25M). A burst of whale moves often comes before bigger price swings.

privacy.contact: Questions about your data? Reach out at the support address listed in Settings → About.
privacy.cookies: We use two strictly necessary cookies: one to keep you logged in (HttpOnly, can't be read by JavaScript) and one for CSRF protection. Neither is used for tracking or advertising — this app has no analytics, ads, or third-party trackers.
privacy.dataCollected: Username and a securely hashed password (we never store your plain-text password). Your email address, used to sign in with a password-reset code if you forget your password. AI provider API keys you choose to connect, encrypted with AES-256 before storage. Your saved forecasts, portfolio analyses, and community sentiment votes.
privacy.intro: This page explains what data AI Crypto Analytics collects, why, and how it's protected. This is a demo/educational project, not a commercial service — but we take the same care with your data regardless.
privacy.rights: You can delete any saved forecast/portfolio analysis, disconnect any API key, or update your email at any time from within the app. You can delete your whole account yourself in Settings.
privacy.thirdParty: Market data comes from CoinGecko and Alternative.me (Fear & Greed Index) — no personal data is sent to them. If you connect your own AI provider API key, your prompts (coin names, portfolio composition) are sent directly to that provider (Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek or xAI) under their own privacy terms.
